title: One Block Ahead: Promoting Sampler State in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Block-diffusion language models denoise a whole block of token positions in parallel so each forward pass can emit many tokens. However, blocks are still denoised in strict sequence, a cost that within-block acceleration leaves untouched. Here, we investigate decoding blocks concurrently and propose One Block Ahead (OBA), a training-free decoding algorithm that denoises the next block alongside the current one. We demonstrate that for uniform-state diffusion LMs, where a block's denoising progress is not visible in its intermediate tokens, concurrent decoding is advantageous if the next block's tokens are promoted together with the corresponding sampler state, including the self-conditioning signal and the denoising time. We also derive a break-even criterion that relates the benefit of OBA to the relative cost of a paired-block forward pass. translated_title: 超前一个区块：在扩散语言模型中提升采样器状态
translated_abstract: 区块扩散语言模型可以并行地去噪整个token位置的区块，因此每次前向传播能够生成多个token。然而，区块之间仍然严格按顺序去噪，这一成本是区块内加速所无法解决的。本文研究了并发解码多个区块，并提出了一种无需训练的解码算法——One Block Ahead（OBA，超前一个区块），它在去噪当前区块的同时对下一个区块进行去噪。我们证明，对于均匀状态扩散语言模型（其区块的去噪进度在中间token中不可见），如果将下一个区块的token与相应的采样器状态（包括自条件信号和去噪时间）一并提升，并发解码是有利的。我们还推导出了一个盈亏平衡准则，将OBA的收益与成对区块前向传播的相对成本联系起来。在最先进的扩散语言模型DiffusionGemma上，OBA使每次前向传播生成的token数量提升了
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的OBA解码算法，通过在去噪当前区块的同时提前解码下一区块并提升相应的采样器状态（包括自条件信号和去噪时间），显著提升了扩散语言模型每次前向传播的token生成量。
en_tdlr: Proposes OBA, a training-free decoding algorithm that accelerates block-diffusion language models by denoising the next block concurrently with the current one, promoting the next block's tokens together with its sampler state (including self-conditioning signal and denoising time).
